title: Use Promise.withResolvers in tests instead of hand-written deferred helpers
notes: newest-read.test.ts:5, manager-reads.test.ts:8 and ship.test.ts:125 each hand-write a deferred promise helper that Promise.withResolvers() already provides (it typechecks and runs here: target ESNext, Node 24). Replace each copy with it. Cost if left: every new test that needs to control when a promise settles writes another copy under another name. Issue: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/issues/192 Review: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/190#discussion_r4441187097

comments.body: Tracks issue #192 (https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/issues/192). The three hand-written deferred helpers are still on main as of ad100b60.
